import httpx, json
base='http://127.0.0.1:9101'
card=httpx.get(base+'/.well-known/agent.json').json()
print('GET /.well-known/agent.json ->', card['name'], '| skills:', [s['id'] for s in card.get('skills', [])])
body={'jsonrpc':'2.0','id':1,'method':'message/send','params':{'message':{'role':'user','messageId':'m1','parts':[{'kind':'text','text':'convert 100 USD to INR'}]}}}
r=httpx.post(base+'/', json=body, timeout=30).json()
task=r.get('result', {})
print('message/send -> task', task.get('id'), 'state =', task.get('status', {}).get('state'))
print(json.dumps(r, indent=1)[:1500])
